name: week
title: Partnerships this week
subtitle: What partners are owed, what goes out next, money due and the rule checks. Demo data is fictional.

sections.title: Partners owed
sections.note: Behind means the share delivered trails the share of the term gone by more than the tolerance in settings.
sections.sql: select partner,asset,promised,delivered,remaining,delivered_pct,elapsed_pct,state from entitlement_status where state in ('behind','past its due date','owed after the deal ended') order by elapsed_pct-delivered_pct desc

sections.title: Events in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select name,held_on,days_away,venue,audience,deliverables from (select e.name,e.held_on,e.held_on-current_date as days_away,e.venue,e.audience,(select count(*)::int from event_deliverables d where d.event_id=e.id and d.remaining>0 and not d.recorded) as deliverables from events e where e.status='scheduled' and e.held_on between current_date and current_date+30) x order by held_on

sections.title: Invoices not yet paid
sections.sql: select name,partner,kind,amount,currency,due_on,state,days_overdue from invoice_status where state not in ('paid','void') order by days_overdue desc nulls last,due_on

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Every rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule,record,area,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,record

name: commercial
title: Commercial picture
subtitle: Inventory sell-through, renewals, pipeline and the value each partner has received.

sections.title: Inventory this season
sections.sql: select name,kind,unit,available,sold,pipeline,unsold,rate,unsold_value from inventory order by unsold_value desc,name

sections.title: Renewals coming due
sections.sql: select name,partner,end_on,days_to_end,total,currency,renewal_status,delivered_pct from renewals order by end_on

sections.title: Pipeline
sections.sql: select name,partner,stage,start_on,total,probability,weighted from pipeline order by weighted desc

sections.title: Value delivered against value paid
sections.note: Value at rate card. Under 1 means the partner has had less than they pay for so far.
sections.sql: select deal,partner,paid_value,promised_value,delivered_value,value_ratio,reach from partner_value order by value_ratio nulls last
